text.tspan: Check replication network path between appliances
Check physical drive or node LED
Verify host is logged in to correct target ports
Identify affected component from event description
Check cable and SFP physical state
Verify FC zone contains both initiator and target WWPNs
Check NTP sync: NAS depends on accurate time for
Check replication Ethernet port and MTU
Provide: PowerStore OS version, appliance serial
Event log export and support bundle
